'''Ifeyina''' is a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Activities ==
She is one of the two Maidens who guard [[Rand al'Thor]] when he defeats the entire [[Shadowspawn]] army singlehandedly outside [[Maradon]]. Ifeyina disagrees with [[Evasni]]'s assessment of Rand's actions.

== Trivia ==
* Ifeyina is named for Ifeyinwa Eboh, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
